plan.title: Closed RFQ Master QCS Project Details navigation

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ on its project summary page.
Open the event's Master QCS tab.
Confirm the Master QCS screen is ready before testing its Project Details control.
Activate the Project Details tab as specified by the case.
Confirm the Project Details page opened and the URL contains the project details route.
